messages:
mike: Heads-up — we're seeing a short 502 spike from 11:12-11:16 in prod. Before I dive in, can people point me at the best dashboards/traces to pull sample request_ids? Also thinking we should tweak the alert debounce (currently 1m) — too chatty for these microbursts.

anya: Start with the 'ingress -> gateway errors' dash (Prod / All Regions) — it has the 502 heatmap + top client IPs. Link: https://dash.redwood/prod/gateway-errors (use the time picker)

sam: For traces, use the trace sampler panel on that dash or query tracing by status: `trace.status_code:502 AND service:gateway` in our trace explorer. Quick curl to fetch a trace by id if you have it:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN" \
  https://traces.redwood/v1/traces/<trace_id>
```

lia: On alerts — agree 1m is noisy. Our usual quick fix is: bump alert to a 3m window with 90th percentile on latency and a sustained error-rate threshold, e.g., `error_rate > 0.5% for 3m` instead of instantaneous count. Also add a `client_ip` cardinality check to avoid noisy single-IP storms.

mike: Nice. Can someone paste the exact prom query you want for the new rule? I'll open a PR to update.

sam: Copy/paste promish: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",status=~"5.."}[1m])) by (job) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway"}[1m])) by (job) * 100` — change the `[1m]` to `[3m]` for debounce and use `> 0.5` for the percent threshold.

anya: Also add a companion alert for `502 count spike` (absolute) so ops can see volume: `increase(http_requests_total{status="502"}[3m]) > 20` (tweak number to your team traffic).

lia: For triage pointers: check `gateway-pool` CPU/GPU saturation, LB 5xx ratio, and prefix-cache miss rate. Dash panels: CPU per pod, active connections, and prefix-cache miss ratio.

mike: Thanks. I'm going to open the PR with the two rule changes (percent + absolute). @anya can you drop the dashboard link into the PR description? @sam can you add a sample trace id or two from 11:13 so I can attach them? :pray:

sam: Will do in 10m — grabbing 3 trace ids now.

deploy-bot: Deployment started for gateway v1.14.3 to prod. Build 4821.

mike: Noted. If the deploy overlaps with the 502 spike we might roll back quick. I'll hold off alert changes until deploy finishes unless noise continues.

anya: If it persists after the deploy, escalate to eng-sre and we can run a short scale-up test. :thumbsup:

mike: Cool — I'll update thread with PR link and sample traces. Thanks team.
